notes:
Add Rule Mapping integrity checks and quieter auth status.

- Added a Rules / Parameter Mapping Integrity section to API reports to flag Rule Mappings attached to Condition Sets owned by a different Fusion Instance.
- Treat Vertex-provided global Condition Sets with Fusion Instance ID 0 as valid defaults, while validating user-defined Condition Sets against their owning Fusion Instance.
- Show Fusion Instance names for invalid Rule Mapping references when available from the cached FusionInstances list, with an explicit unknown-owner message when access is limited.
- Reduced noisy auth/debug details in the main window while preserving the full trace in the auth log.
